Adam Smith suggests to Li Hua that she should use removable hooks to hang her artwork in order to prevent any damage to the walls. This advice indicates Adam Smith's helpful and considerate approach towards maintaining Li Hua's living space while ensuring that the decoration is practical and safe. Removable hooks provide a secure option for hanging pictures without leaving permanent marks or holes on the wall, thereby safeguarding the integrity of the wall finish. This solution speaks to Adam Smith's willingness to provide thoughtful and supportive guidance in matters related to Li Hua's domestic arrangements.
